QUARTERLY MARKETING REPORT

This report was copied straight out of a PDF file,
so it drags an automatic line break at the end of
every visual line and the odd double  space along
the way.

The client approved the campaign budget on Monday.
Basically the budget covers three months of work,
although the client asked to review the campaign
calendar before signing anything.

Agreed goals:
1. Grow incoming budget requests by 20%.
2. Bring down the campaign cost per contact.
3. Deliver the marketing report every month.

Still to confirm
- The final media budget.
- The delivery date of the report .
- Whether the client provides their own photography.

Actually the main risk is the calendar: obviously if
the client takes too long to review the docu-
ment, the whole campaign slips and the marketing
report loses its value.
